task.title: AFC-01 secure contained resource readers
task.description: Implement containment-spec.md and T5 tests through reusable lib/contained-read seam; permit internal links, refuse external/owner-root replacement and descriptor identity races. Reuse/extract SAC descriptor primitives without forbidden cross-module dependency or weakening SAC no-follow semantics. Integrate MCP resource listing/read and harness wiki/skills discovery/read; bounded cycles, file types and byte limits. Preserve safe typed errors and explicit unsupported platform refusal. Read typed T6-input.json.

acceptance_criteria: Ordinary file and internal link chain return same bytes inside narrow owner root.
External/sibling/root-replacement links and nonfiles/unreadable paths cannot disclose synthetic sentinel or unsafe target names.
MCP resource listing and harness wiki/skills discovery/direct reads observe the same containment rules; cycles are bounded.
Race test verifies descriptor/identity protection or explicit capability refusal; no unsupported full TOCTOU claim.
constraints: Read /Users/Goodea/goodea/keryx/.metaproject/index.md first, local task-implementer SKILL fully and testing context.

Own src/lib/contained-read.ts and lower-level new shared descriptor helper, SAC secure-resource-read extraction/re-export if necessary, src/mcp/resources.ts and harness/tool/metaproject-adapter.ts, associated tests. Do not edit dispatch.ts/redact-seam.ts/security modules; root owns them.
No package/lock/flow/git changes. Other worker health, root lint config and child-budget correction; no conflicting writes. New source files require graph refresh before relying on graph.
SAC no-follow denial must stay unchanged; do not import SAC internals into MCP/harness. No merely realpath-then-open race claim. Fail closed where capability unavailable.
Temporary synthetic fixtures only, no external network/model calls, auto_commit false, stats disabled. Focused tests not full while health RED active.
New reader must reject FIFOs/directories before blocking read, bound actual bytes and verify root/file identity as claimed. Test seam hook must exercise real production entrypoint.
